}}'''Maira''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Maiden of the Spear]]. She is of the [[Serai]] [[Sept]] of the [[Tomanelle]] Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Maira}}

== Appearance ==
She has red hair.

== Activities ==
She takes off to dance the spears during a night attack on the Aiel's camp by [[Shadowspawn]]. While she is gone, [[Rand al'Thor]] is attacked by a [[Draghkar]]. When her and the rest of the Maidens who were supposed to be guarding him find out, they all receive punishments from the [[Wise One]]s in the form of carrying a doll.

She is one of Rands guards when he goes to [[Black Tower|the farm]].
